projection.note: The raw sheet shows a broadly consistent top/front camera and the authored reference has the intended square-grid projection. However the sanitized registration contains no delivered candidate frames or placement previews, so the actual runtime projection cannot receive a visual pass.

complete-art.note: The generated source already truncates outer hands at sheet edges, notably the upper-right and lower-left source cells; the lower-left arm/hand runs into the left canvas boundary. No processed candidate frames are supplied to establish complete frame delivery. The attractive authored reference does not repair the clipped generated source.

anchor-placement.note: The authored floor guide establishes the intended floor-center root, but there are no registered processed candidate frames or placement previews to compare physically with it. The source alone does not establish the runtime ground anchor.

same-player.note: The twelve raw panels appear to share the same brown-haired blue-shirted character, belt, trousers and boots, with similar frontal lighting. With no delivered candidate frames or candidate playback, I cannot validate consistency of the runtime animation.

dancing-poses.note: The source visibly contains twelve arm-wave pose panels with two arms/legs generally readable, though some outer hands are clipped. There is no delivered frame sequence or actual candidate playback to validate twelve useful delivered dance poses forming a readable loop.

design-height.note: The raw panels look broadly similar in anatomy scale and the authored neutral/reference provides the nominal target, but there are no delivered candidate frames to compare against that target at runtime scale. I do not infer standing height from the source silhouette bounds or treat the authored rig as candidate evidence.

contact-stability.note: No processed candidate sequence or physical floor placements are supplied. The fixed roots shown by the authored guide describe the reference only; they cannot establish stable candidate support, absence of per-frame fitting, or absence of rescaling.

cutout-quality.note: The raw generated source has conspicuous red/yellow/gray/blue fringes and smears outside arms, shoulders, torso sides and the gap between boots. These are visible background/color contamination rather than character material. No delivered processed cutouts on light/dark backgrounds are supplied to show that this has been resolved.

loop.note: There are no delivered candidate frames and no candidate 12fps playback. I did not substitute a rigged-reference/control playback or infer the 12-to-1 transition from a contact sheet, so unintended pop and scale jump remain unvalidated.

source-faithfulness.note: Only the generated source and authored references are supplied; the registration has no candidate sprites or processing operations. There is no delivered processed artwork to compare for source-faithful extraction or undeclared geometry fitting.
